overview.title: Overview
overview.lead: Your team's training at a glance: seats, assignments and certificates.

stats.employeesHint: People linked to your company account

seats.title: Seats by course
seats.caption: Purchased, assigned and remaining seats for each course
seats.emptyBody: Buy seats for a course, then assign them to your employees on the session dates that suit them.

next.title: Next step
next.buyBody: Choose a course and the number of seats you need. Seats can be used on any upcoming session of that course.
next.inviteBody: You have seats ready. Invite your employees so that you can assign seats to them.
next.assignBody: {count, plural, one {You have 1 seat that has not been assigned yet.} other {You have # seats that have not been assigned yet.}} Choose an employee and a session date.
next.remindBody: {count, plural, one {1 invitation has not been accepted yet.} other {# invitations have not been accepted yet.}} Remind your colleagues to check their email, or send a new invitation if the link has been lost.
next.doneBody: Your seats are assigned and there are no pending invitations. Follow your team's progress in the report.

employees.title: Employees
employees.lead: Invite your employees, then follow their training from booking to certificate.

invite.title: Invite an employee
invite.body: We email a personal link. Once the employee creates an account with the same email address, they appear in your team.
invite.name: Full name

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.caption: Invitations sent to employees
invitations.name: Name
invitations.revokeConfirm: Revoke this invitation? The link in the email will stop working.
invitations.emptyBody: Invitations you send will be listed here with their status.

team.title: Team
team.caption: Employees and their training progress
team.emptyBody: Invite your first employee using the form above.

seats.title: Seats
seats.lead: Buy seats for a course, then assign each seat to an employee on a session date.

buy.title: Buy seats
buy.body: Seats are bought per course and can be used on any upcoming session of that course.
buy.vatNote: Prices exclude VAT. VAT is calculated and shown at checkout before you pay.
buy.noCourses: No courses are available for purchase at the moment.

assign.title: Assign a seat
assign.body: The employee receives access to the session and its joining details in their own account.
assign.noSeatsBody: All purchased seats are assigned, or no seats have been bought yet. Buy seats to continue.
assign.noSessionsBody: There are no upcoming sessions with free places for the courses you hold seats for. New dates are added regularly.

current.title: Upcoming assignments
current.body: A seat can be released until the session starts, and then assigned to someone else.
current.caption: Seats assigned for upcoming sessions
current.releaseConfirm: Release this seat? The employee will lose their place in the session and the seat returns to your balance.
current.emptyBody: Seats you assign for future sessions will be listed here.

reports.title: Reports
reports.lead: Training progress for every employee your company has sponsored.
reports.downloadHint: The file opens in Excel and includes Arabic text.
reports.caption: Training progress report
reports.emptyBody: Once you assign seats to employees, their progress will appear here.
reports.unauthenticated: Sign in to download this report.
reports.forbidden: Only company managers can download this report.

details.title: Company details
details.lead: These details appear on your orders and invoices.
details.name: Company name
details.phoneHint: Saudi mobile number, for example 05X XXX XXXX.
details.vatHint: 15 digits, as shown on your VAT certificate.
